title: LPC company profile (demo)
implementation_note: WordCraft (the vendored WASM Word editor) loads a static index.html in an iframe with no observed postMessage/param channel to pre-load a document, and its vendor bundle is not even present in this checkout (fetched separately). No engine code was touched or guessed at.
